-allow.help: Allowed list of IP/CIDR's to be proxied

-config.help: path to the proxify configuration file

-deny.help: Denied list of IP/CIDR's to be proxied

-dns-addr.help: Listening DNS IP and Port address (ip:port)

-dns-mapping.help: Domain to IP DNS mapping (eg domain:ip,domain:ip,..)

-dump-req.help: Dump only HTTP requests to output file

-dump-resp.help: Dump only HTTP responses to output file

-http-addr.help: Listening HTTP IP and Port address (ip:port) (default "127.0.0.1:8888")

-kafka-topic.help: kafka topic to publish messages on (default "proxify")

-log-dir.help: path to proxify's output log directory

-max-size.help: Max export data size (request/responses will be truncated) (default 9223372036854775807)

-out-ca.help: Generate and Save CA File to filename

-output.help: output file to store proxify logs (default proxify_logs.jsonl)

-output-spec.help: file to store Swagger/OpenAPI specification (example: OpenAPI.yaml)

-socks-addr.help: Listening SOCKS IP and Port address (ip:port) (default 127.0.0.1:10080)

-store-response.help: store raw http request / response to output directory (default proxify_logs)

-store-resposne.help: store raw http request / response to output directory (default proxify_logs)
